steps.text: Beef (110/145 g) into THREE loose balls per person. Don't season them, don't compact them.
Tortillas (42/55 g) — cut down into smaller rounds if yours are large.
Avocado (35/50 g) mashed with the oil (9/11 g, olive — finishing) and a squeeze of lime.
Heavy pan, dry, high, a full 3 minutes.
Balls in, pressed flat and hard with a spatula for 10 seconds each. Salt the tops. 90 seconds untouched.
Flip, cheddar (15/20 g) on, 45 seconds. Out.
Tortillas 20 seconds a side in the beef fat left behind.
Build onto the avocado: patty, salsa (50/60 g), lettuce (50/60 g), tomato (70/90 g), raw onion (30/40 g). Lime hard.

why: Three small patties, not one big one. Crust-to-meat ratio is the entire reason a smashed patty tastes the way it does, and splitting the same mince three ways gives you half again as much of it.
notes: Ingredient-in-method-text gap fixed (PLAN §4 audit finding, not a numbered D0 defect): the original card's oil row (9/11 g) never appeared in any step despite being in the ingredient table — the pan is explicitly dry and the tortillas finish in rendered beef fat, so oil was never mentioned at all. Placed here in the avocado-mash step as a finishing drizzle; grams unchanged, no macro impact from this fix.
D0-003: since this oil's only sensible use is the raw avocado finish (the pan is dry by the card's own instruction, so no pan-heat use exists to assign rapeseed to), it stays olive_oil, unchanged.

Lettuce substitution considered and NOT applied: the build step gives no 'shredded'/'torn'/'leaf' descriptor either way (unlike b-d3d's explicit 'torn' or b-d5l's why-text 'a leaf of lettuce'), so this is left as lettuce rather than guessed into sweetheart_cabbage.

Two light tracks (pan: patties+tortillas; prep: tortilla-cutting, avocado, build) — the patties cook fast enough that the parallelism is modest, but genuinely there (avocado/tortilla prep happens during the pan's 3-minute preheat).
